svg.text: CT6 energy monitor: final wiring, 6 CT + ZMPT101B voltage (breadboard-proven values)
One shared BIAS feeds all 6 CT channels. Each channel is identical: fit the 24 Ω burden only when that channel uses a 100A/50mA CT.
• Power the module from 5 V (DevKit 5V/VIN). Its LM358 cannot swing high enough on 3.3 V.
• 10k/22k scales OUT (≈2.5 V centre) to ≈1.7 V at GPIO9. Check GPIO9 with a meter: DC ≈ 1.7 V, never > 3.3 V.
• Mains L/N go ONLY into the module's screw terminal, through a 100 mA fuse. Never on the breadboard.
• The CT6 PCB replaces this module with its own on-board ZMPT101B circuit (same GPIO9).
Home Assistant settings per CT type
* GPIO10 bias monitor is optional: BIAS → 1k → GPIO10.
Current firmware reads CT1 only; 6-ch + voltage firmware is next.
Shared bias: R1, R2 10 kΩ ×2 · C1 100 µF ×1
Tip = signal, Sleeve = BIAS, Ring = not used.
Keep each R_B's legs right at its own jack.
1. Meter Ω tip↔sleeve, CT plugged, unclamped:
2. Unclamped: Bias ≈1.6 V, RMS few mV, Clipped 0
3. Clamp ONE wire (live only), small load first
Never run a 100A/50mA CT without its 24 Ω burden.
No 230 V wiring on the breadboard.
ADC1 pins only; avoid GPIO3 and GPIO11–20.
